HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   B. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.
   D. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.
   C. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.

3. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.
   C. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.

5. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

6. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.
   B. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.
   D. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

9. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.

10. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   D. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.

11. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.

12. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   C. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Global Wars and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain American Revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain International organisations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Modern slavery and servitude Page 15 of 75 xiii 3.4 Global governance 3.5 1st Ge and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
